note: Popov-Chang syndrome is primarily characterized by intellectual disability, developmental delay, and behavioral differences, making a low prevalence of refractory epileptic encephalopathy plausible.

evidence.text: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) are defined by refractory seizures, developmental regression or delay associated with epileptic activity, whereas genetic causes like YWHAZ are associated with broader neurodevelopmental disorders.

source.title: Recent advances in epilepsy genomics and genetic testing
source.quote: Developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) are a group of severe, early onset epilepsies characterized by refractory seizures, developmental delay or regression associated with ongoing epileptic activity, and generally poor prognosis.
